claims: The Full Moon for April is known as the "Pink Moon".
The Pink Moon reaches peak illumination on Wednesday, April 1, 2026 at 10:12 p.m. EDT.
The Pink Moon will appear full in the sky for both Tuesday and Wednesday nights.
The Pink Moon is visible after sunset on April 1, 2026 and through the night.
The moon will begin shifting to a waning gibbous on Thursday, April 2, 2026.
The full moon marks the time when the Moon is opposite the Sun.
The full moon appears fully illuminated.
